system.description:
Winged Elf (Avariel)

The avariel, or winged elves, are the rarest and most spectacular of the elven subraces. These elves possess large, feathered wings that allow true flight. Their bones are slightly hollow to reduce weight, and their builds are lighter and more fragile than other elves. Avariel typically have white or ivory skin, dramatic dark or bright hair, and eyes like brilliant gemstones. They live in aeries high in remote mountain ranges and are regarded with wonder and envy by other races. Due to their hollow bones and restricted lifestyles, avariel are endangered and exceptionally rare.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Dexterity: +2
  • Strength: −1
  • Constitution: −1

Racial Traits

  • Flight: Avariel can fly at a movement rate of 18 (maneuverability class B). They cannot fly while wearing medium or heavy armor.
  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Resistance to Sleep and Charm: 90% immunity to sleep spells and +2 bonus on saving throws vs. charm and hold spells.
  • Detect Secret and Concealed Doors: 1-in-6 passively, 2-in-6 when actively searching.
  • Aerial Combat: Avariel receive a +1 bonus to attack rolls when fighting while airborne.
  • Wing Vulnerability: Avariel wings can be targeted in combat. A wing hit causes 50% movement reduction. Both wings damaged grounds the elf.
  • Weapon Proficiency Bonus: +1 to attack rolls with bows (which they can fire in flight).

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Magic-User, Thief; Fighter/Magic-User, Fighter/Thief, Magic-User/Thief multiclass. DM permission required to play this rare race.
